address: 3F, M+ Tower, West Kowloon Cultural District, 38 Museum Drive, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Nestled in an art museum with commanding panoramic harbour views, the spacious room imparts serenity with its concrete walls and sprinkling of lights that resemble a starry sky. Executive chef Sung Anh lead the kitchen team of mostly Korean natives as they craft a single tasting menu that reflects the chefs’ multicultural backgrounds. Creativity and modern techniques are applied to top-notch local and Korean ingredients....
